questions.question: Conflict: decision 0144 keeps a denied row on the card with a one-tap Reconsider (so the job can be un-denied later); AC2 would retire it into a buttonless receipt. Which wins?
options: Keep 0144: denied rows stay live with Reconsider; a card only vanishes when every row is allowed; expired rows get the receipt (Recommended)
Amend 0144: Deny is final; denied rows retire into 'Permission denied: <command>' receipts
questions.chosen: Keep 0144: denied rows stay live with Reconsider; a card only vanishes when every row is allowed; expired rows get the receipt (Recommended)
